description: This is a small, upholstered stool with a wooden frame. The seat is covered in a dark plaid fabric, featuring a pattern of dark grey, black, and white lines. The wooden legs are turned and have a light, natural wood finish, with a slightly distressed or aged appearance. The stool is sturdy and appears to be well-constructed, suitable for use as a footrest, extra seating, or even as a small side table in a variety of settings. Its classic design makes it versatile and able to complement different decor styles.
